equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet, 2026-06-30; charged once here, flows left consolidated

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: management's FY2025 goodwill-impairment-test revenue assumption of 2.5%-6% p.a. for FY2026-30 (cut from 4%-10% a year earlier), taken at the low-middle because DRG/DIP 3.0 (March 2026) extends the revenue-per-patient compression; historical CAGRs are not usable as forward guides (see notes)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 11.1% vs EPS 3yr CAGR -29.5% and revenue 7.9%: diverges >30pp. Equity grew on retained earnings from the FY2021-24 build-out while EPS collapsed on the FY2025 goodwill impairment and DRG-driven revenue decline; revenue 5yr CAGR 23.4% is acquisition- and greenfield-led (Suzhou Yongding, Hezhou, Wuxi) and will not recur now the pipeline ends with Changshu.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income): FY2020 -33.6, FY2021 -251.7, FY2022 23.1, FY2023 -197.4, FY2024 101.2, FY2025 463.1. The 3yr CAGR from a RMB23m base is meaningless and the 5yr starts negative (null). FCF has been negative or trivial for most of the history because the group was in a greenfield/acquisition build-out; FY2025's RMB463m reflects the capex downcycle plus a working-capital release. EPS CAGRs are on reported EPS (RMB0.27 FY2025 after the impairment; non-IFRS adjusted net profit RMB455.5m = ~RMB0.74/share).

scenario_narratives.base: DRG/DIP is a permanent reset, not a cliff: revenue per patient keeps drifting down a few percent a year while volumes grow ~4% (visits) and ~8% (surgeries, with Level 3/4 complex cases growing fastest), so group revenue is roughly flat in FY2026 and compounds 3-4.5% in FY2027-29 as Wuxi and then Changshu — the last self-built hospital — fill. Operating EBITDA margin recovers 1.5pp from the FY2025 trough (23-24%) to ~25.5% on maturing new campuses and a slowly rising self-pay/commercial-insurance mix, but never returns to the 27-31% pre-reform level. Capex falls to a ~7% of revenue maintenance level equal to D&A, which is what turns a decade of negative owner FCF into RMB450-750m a year and funds the RMB500m/yr return plan. No further acquisitions are modelled; no further goodwill impairments either (the Etern write-down is treated as the one-off it was reported as).
scenario_narratives.bull: DRG/DIP 3.0 stabilises reimbursement after the FY2025 reset and the group's high CMI (case-mix index) and complex-surgery mix is rewarded rather than penalised under the refined grouping. Wuxi and Changshu ramp faster than the historical 3-5 year hospital maturation, self-pay services (screening, aesthetics, dental, weight management), 70+ commercial insurers and inbound medical tourism lift the non-NHSA payer share, and revenue compounds 5-7% through FY2030. Margins rebuild to 28% as the fixed campus cost base is absorbed. Capex still falls to maintenance level, so FCF conversion is strongest here; buybacks at today's ~6.5x EV/EBITDA are accretive beyond what the flat-count convention credits.
scenario_narratives.bear: DRG/DIP 3.0 and local insurance-fund pressure cut revenue per patient faster than volumes grow; revenue falls another 3-4% over FY2026-27 and then grows only ~1.5% — volume growth net of continued price erosion. Margins compress to ~21.5% as physician cost inflation runs ahead of reimbursement, more acquired hospitals (Suzhou Yongding again, Hezhou, Yixing) miss their CGU forecasts and attract further impairments, and Changshu ramps slowly in a weak Jiangsu macro. Capex stays somewhat above D&A to keep accreditation and equipment current. The business remains cash-generative and solvent — this is a value trap path, not a solvency path — but the RMB1.5bn return plan is only partly delivered because M&A 'dry powder' is prioritised.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value Hygeia as a mature, price-regulated hospital network entering its harvest phase, not as the 20%-CAGR roll-up it was through FY2023. The build-out (17 hospitals, ~14,000 beds, ~940,000 sqm of self-owned property) is complete bar Changshu, so the question is what free cash flow a flat-to-low-growth, DRG-constrained network produces once capex falls to maintenance. Earnings power is anchored on FY2025 ex the RMB283m goodwill impairment and ex RMB65m of financial-asset gains (the assets sit in the cash bridge), i.e. operating EBITDA of ~RMB930m on RMB4.0bn revenue, and never recovers to pre-reform margins. The terminal value is capped at 15x FCF and the bear case is weighted 30% because the dominant risk is regulatory and one-directional. At ~6.5x EV/underlying EBITDA and ~10.6x adjusted earnings the market is pricing the bear path as the central case; the DCF says the base path is worth materially more, with the gap being a bet on DRG/DIP stabilising rather than on growth.
key_risks_to_valuation: Further DRG/DIP tightening (3.0 subgrouping, local fund-level price cuts) compressing revenue per patient faster than volume growth — the bear axis
Additional goodwill impairments on acquired hospitals (RMB2.4bn+ goodwill and acquisition intangibles) if other CGUs follow Suzhou Yongding
Capex not falling to the assumed 7% maintenance level — a new acquisition or greenfield programme would reverse the FCF inflection
Margin anchor sensitivity: each 1pp of EBITDA margin is worth roughly HK$0.9-1.0/share; the FY2025 ex-gains margin (23.1%) vs FY2024 (25.3%) is a 2pp range
CNY/HKD rate drift; a stale fx_rate after a price-only refresh misstates HKD per-share values
Capital-return plan (RMB1.5bn FY2026-28) diverted to M&A at prices that destroy value

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API, regular close at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range HK$8.10-14.55
data_sources.financials: 6078.HK_Metrics.csv / core_metrics (FY2019-FY2025, H1 FY2023-H1 FY2026); 6078.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt (cash-flow statement, non-IFRS reconciliation, lease and borrowing notes, tax note, option scheme); 6078.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt (balance sheet 2026-06-30, cash-flow statement, share capital, treasury shares, EPS note)
data_sources.qualitative: 6078.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-24): DRG/DIP reform, Etern impairment, RMB1.5bn return plan, Changshu completion, management's goodwill-test growth range 2.5-6%

inputs.share_count_basis: 618,499,000 shares in issue less 10,758,000 treasury shares at 2026-06-30 (H1 FY2026 interim report, Share Capital section and Purchase/Sale/Redemption statement) = 607.741m. 4.8m share options outstanding at exercise price HK$66.80 are ~7x out of the money and anti-dilutive (interim note 10: diluted EPS = basic). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed at 0% in the flows and buybacks are value-neutral by house convention. Buybacks continued after 30 June under the RMB300m programme (12.85m shares cumulative for ~RMB120m at 27 Aug 2026), so the count is if anything slightly high.
inputs.cash_note: Cash 413.671 + FVPL wealth-management products 301.486 + restricted deposits 37.247 + term deposits >3m 6.600 = 759.004 (interim balance sheet 2026-06-30; matches management's own RMB759.0m liquidity total). Lease liabilities (8.041) are EXCLUDED from total_debt under lease treatment (B). Company-defined net debt excludes the FVPL products; they are included here because they are churned continuously (RMB983m bought / RMB971m redeemed in H1 FY2026) and are cash-equivalent in substance, and the FY2025 RMB65.0m fair-value gain on them has correspondingly been stripped from the EBITDA margin anchor (matching-asset rule).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report statement of changes in equity and non-IFRS reconciliation: share-based payments were a CREDIT of RMB9.043m in FY2025 and RMB10.736m in FY2024 (forfeiture reversals of the HK$66.80 option grant); H1 FY2026 charge RMB1.069m. A negative SBC is not an owner benefit, so SBC is set to 0 in the owner-FCF base and 0% in the forward path. Equity-award taxes nil (no net-share settlement).
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 financing outflow RMB39.9m; H1 FY2026 RMB87.5m; FY2024 RMB168.1m. Board plan RMB1.5bn over FY2026-28 (~RMB500m/yr) via buybacks and/or dividends — authorised, not yet spent; flat count assumption is funded by actual repurchases.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1748 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-23. Direction check: USD/HKD ~7.78 over USD/CNY ~6.62 = 1.175. No dual listing exists for a parity check. Statements, flows and the DCF are in CNY (RMB); per-share values are converted to HKD for comparison with the HKEX quote. refresh_price.py does not move fx_rate — re-check the rate on any later price refresh.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' currency. Cost of equity 11.0% = 10Y CGB ~1.8% + beta 1.2 x China ERP 6.5% + 1.4pp size/liquidity premium for a HK$5.7bn HKEX small-cap. Pre-tax cost of debt 3.8% (FY2025 interest paid RMB87.3m on ~RMB2.3bn average borrowings), 2.9% after 25% tax. Weights at market: equity RMB4.83bn / debt RMB2.26bn = 68/32 -> 8.4%; rounded UP to 9.0% for the secured, equity-pledged nature of the borrowings. DRG/DIP policy risk is charged in the scenario weights (bear 30%), NOT as a further WACC premium — risk charged once. Same WACC in all three scenarios. Cross-check: company's own goodwill-test pre-tax discount rate 17.8% (~13-14% post-tax) is a CGU-level rate for an impaired acquired hospital, not a group WACC.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost. Lease payments incl. interest were RMB4.1m FY2025 / RMB1.7m H1 FY2026 (cash-flow statement, financing), i.e. 0.1% of revenue — charged via lease_cost_pct_path 0.1% and lease liabilities (RMB8.0m) excluded from total_debt. Hospitals are all self-owned, so leases are immaterial either way.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated; NCI stock of RMB16.394m (2026-06-30) deducted once in equity_bridge. NCI profit share is ~nil (RMB0.03m H1 FY2026, -RMB3.0m FY2025), so no leakage driver.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF, 10-year horizon, scenario-weighted. Routed via dcf-methods SKILL.md row 'Operating company, non-US' — Hygeia is an operating hospital network (17 self-owned oncology-centred hospitals, ~14,000 beds, 100% mainland China) whose value is a stream of fee-for-service cash flow; nothing in the business straddles a REIT/bank/holdco row. Adaptations applied: CNY flows vs HKD quote (fx_rate), lease treatment (B), NCI in bridge, matching-asset rule for FVPL products, SBC-zero (house = street, band_position null). FY0 = FY2025 revenue RMB4,008.8m. EBITDA MARGIN ANCHOR: headline FY2025 EBITDA RMB697.3m (17.4%) is after the RMB283.3m non-cash Etern/Suzhou Yongding goodwill impairment; adding it back gives RMB980.6m (24.5%), and stripping the RMB52.9m of 'other gains' (dominated by RMB65.0m FVPL fair-value gains whose source asset sits in the cash bridge) gives an operating EBITDA margin of 23.1% for FY2025 vs 25.3% on the same basis for FY2024 and ~25% in H1 FY2025/H1 FY2026 headline. The impairment is treated as non-recurring; the DRG/DIP revenue-per-patient compression that drove the FY2025 revenue decline (-9.8%) is treated as STRUCTURAL and lives in the growth and margin paths, not just the risk list. CASH TAX: 25% statutory CIT on EBIT in all scenarios (FY2024 cash tax 23% of PBT; FY2025 33% on impairment-depressed PBT; FY2025 book rate 27% of underlying PBT). CAPEX: FY2025 RMB483.6m (12.1%) down 21% YoY, H1 FY2026 RMB162.4m (8.3%), Changshu (last self-built hospital) completes 2026; path converges to 7.0% of revenue = D&A terminal 7.0% (steady-state maintenance incl. equipment replacement on self-owned campuses). Working capital capture 0%: payables (RMB1,112m) exceed receivables + inventory (RMB778m), so growth does not consume cash, but the FY2025 working-capital release is not projected to repeat. Terminal cap 15x FCF (structurally slower, price-regulated business) binds vs Gordon 15.8x at 9%/2.5% in base. Price is the Friday 2026-10-23 HKEX regular close; not an after-hours print.

base.growth_note: FY2026 -0.5%: H1 FY2026 revenue -1.4% with H2 FY2025 comp already down 2.2%, Wuxi (17th hospital) ramping from H1 FY2026. FY2027-29 3.0-4.5%: Changshu opens and ramps, volumes +4% / surgeries +8% p.a. net of continuing DRG/DIP price compression; inside management's 2.5-6% goodwill-test range. Fades to 2.5% terminal.
base.margin_note: 24.0% FY2026 (between FY2025 ex-impairment ex-gains 23.1% and FY2024 25.3%; H1 FY2026 gross margin +0.8pp YoY) rising 1.5pp over five years as Wuxi/Changshu mature and self-pay/commercial-insurance mix grows; never recovers to the FY2021-23 27-31% pre-DRG level.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30% because the single most important variable — reimbursement per diagnosis group — is set by one regulator (NHSA) whose reform is still being refined (DRG/DIP 3.0, March 2026) and whose fiscal incentive is to tighten; FY2025 already showed volumes rising while revenue fell 9.8%, and management cut its own 5-year growth range. Bull cut to 20% because it needs several independent things to go right at once: DRG stabilisation, faster-than-historical Wuxi/Changshu ramps, and a payer-mix shift that is still small. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
